name: GitHub Issue Fix
description: Investigates a repository, separates reporter claims from code/test evidence, reproduces and root-causes a GitHub Issue prepared by skf-github-issue-brief, then implements the minimal fix and reports PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN validation results. Supports a --plan mode that never touches a file. Can prepare every issue of a GitHub Project board (--board) or of the repository (--all) at once, as a queue to fix one by one. --next offers to commit and push each validated fix, on the current branch or on a dedicated fix branch, then comments the issue with the commit (and pull request) link and the validation results.
